user.title: APsystems OpenAPI
user.description: Enter your APsystems OpenAPI credentials and polling preferences.

data_description.inverter_telemetry: Creates the per-inverter sensors and buttons. Costs 1 API call per inverter per day. Turning this off removes the inverter devices.
data_description.batch_power: Fetches the whole day's power series once per ECU at 23:00 (1 API call per ECU per day). Nothing displays it; it only appears in the diagnostics download.
data_description.storage_data: Creates a device per storage ECU (e.g. ELT-12) with battery state of charge and lifetime battery, grid import and grid export energy for the Energy dashboard. Costs 2 API calls per storage ECU on every poll, so the automatic polling interval gets longer. Only for systems with an APsystems battery.
data_description.sid: System ID as shown in EMA.
data_description.auto_scan_interval: When enabled, the polling interval is sized automatically to stay within the API quota. Disable to use the fixed interval below.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between API calls during solar hours (1800-7200). Ignored when automatic optimisation is enabled.
data_description.sunrise_offset: Minutes to wait after sunrise before starting API calls (0-120).
data_description.sunset_offset: Minutes to keep polling after sunset before stopping (0-120).

init.title: APsystems OpenAPI options
init.description:
Adjust how often the integration polls the APsystems API and which optional features are collected.

With the saved settings the integration uses an estimated **{estimate}** API calls per month in the busiest season (allowance reported by the original project: {quota}). The estimate refreshes after you save.

data_description.inverter_telemetry: Creates the per-inverter sensors and buttons. Costs 1 API call per inverter per day. Turning this off removes the inverter devices.
data_description.batch_power: Fetches the whole day's power series once per ECU at 23:00 (1 API call per ECU per day). Nothing displays it; it only appears in the diagnostics download.
data_description.storage_data: Creates a device per storage ECU (e.g. ELT-12) with battery state of charge and lifetime battery, grid import and grid export energy for the Energy dashboard. Costs 2 API calls per storage ECU on every poll, so the automatic polling interval gets longer. Only for systems with an APsystems battery.
data_description.auto_scan_interval: When enabled, the polling interval is sized automatically to stay within the API quota, taking the optional features above into account. Disable to use the fixed interval below.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between API calls during solar hours (1800-7200). Ignored when automatic optimisation is enabled.
data_description.sunrise_offset: Minutes to wait after sunrise before starting API calls (0-120).
data_description.sunset_offset: Minutes to keep polling after sunset before stopping (0-120).

api_limit.title: APsystems API limit reached
api_limit.description:
The APsystems OpenAPI reported: {reason}.

Data updates are paused until the limit resets. To stay under the monthly quota, increase the polling interval under Settings > Devices & services > APsystems OpenAPI > Configure.
